notes: B&H plate dated 1573 in the Polona record; used the vol. 2 year 1575 per the rule. Merian dated 1652 (Topographia Prussiae et Pomerelliae). Deisch album preface is dated 10 July 1765, so the plate is labeled about 1765. Postcard #33 year 1916 is the Commons date (likely postmark), hence about 1916. No P6 Quality image among candidates; #38 shows the same landmarks but with a highway in front. Photochrom credited to Photoglob Zürich from the “P.Z.” imprint on the print (record names no maker).
